title: Progressive Overload
hook: Progressive Overload
caption:
Progressive Overload

Muscle growth doesn’t happen by accident. Progressive overload is the foundation of long-term development. 

By gradually increasing the demands placed on your body, you create a reason for it to adapt. Train with intention, track your progress, and give your body a reason to grow.

Progressive overload isn’t just about lifting heavier. 

Adding repetitions, improving control, increasing range of motion, and strategically adjusting training volume can all contribute to progress. 

The objective is simple: challenge your muscles more effectively over time.
